data.title: 摩根 · 湖畔咏唱
data.description: 【摩根 · 湖畔咏唱】妖精湖畔，救世主形态的梣站在齐膝的浅水里咏唱古老的咒语，蓝袍下摆浸在水中，指尖泛起细碎的光——「以救世之名，让这片湖记住今天的风。」
data.action: 站在齐膝浅水中咏唱，一手稳住法杖，另一手指尖聚起细光
data.camera: medium-full shot, knee-deep waterline and both hands visible
data.promptProse: Aesc chants while standing knee-deep in the faerie lake, one hand steadying her staff on the lakebed and the other gathering small lights at its raised fingertips. The opaque blue robe's lower edge rests in water beneath the dry capelet. The medium-full view includes both gestures and spreading ripples, aquatic plants farther away. Reflected daylight illuminates her face and silver hair; the fingertip glow gently touches her raised sleeve.
